answer:
WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2024 (2023 data):
- Fell ill: "an estimated 10.8 million people fell ill with TB in 2023"
- Died: "TB caused an estimated 1.25 million deaths in 2023, including 161 000 among people with HIV"
- Treatment: "The treatment success rate for drug-susceptible TB remains high (at 88%) and has improved to 68% for MDR/RR-TB." 88% is drug-susceptible only, not overall.
